race.comment: CASTAWAY (2) has switched north and steps out in new colours. His Vic formlines are hardly encouraging but his two trials in readiness suggest he's come back in great order. Thompson's booking signals intent. The gelded KINGS DOMAIN (5) has stronger exposed maiden substance, including a close Pakenham fourth over the mile before failing at 2000m, and the fresh start for Trevor Thomas with a claim gives him a genuine reset. RISING QUEEN (11) has been safely held in two starts, yet the Chris Waller and Ryan Maloney combination gives her more upside than most if she improves second-up. AKIRA SAN (8) caught the eye here last time when closing off strongly into the placings and third-up fitness keeps her firmly in the mix, though the wide barrier will likely see her get back again. KING CHANCE (4) didn't fire a shot first-up but can improve with that run under his belt.
